item.title: Iran is 'trying to give the global economy a heart attack' by closing Strait of Hormuz, UAE minister says
item.summary: United Arab Emirates official Lana Nusseibeh criticized Iran's restrictions on the Strait of Hormuz and its use of ballistic missiles and drones during an interview with Fox News.

item.title: US moves airborne troops, Marines as Iran rejects ceasefire, raising ground war potential
item.summary: The U.S. deployed the 82nd Airborne and thousands of Marines and sailors to the Middle East, and experts say limited Iran operations could target the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Howie Mandel calls out Kelly Ripa’s backhanded compliment in tense live TV moment
item.summary: Howie Mandel called out Kelly Ripa and Mark Consuelos live on air, saying their age-based compliment was really an insult during his visit around his 70th birthday.

item.title: Illegal immigrant accused of groping girls at Virginia high school facing new charges
item.summary: An illegal immigrant accused of groping female students at Fairfax High School in Virginia was served with four more counts after additional victims came forward.

item.title: House Budget chairman reveals how Republicans will pay for the Iran campaign
item.summary: House Republicans will push a second budget reconciliation bill to fund Trump's Iran campaign and cut fraud in social services, House Budget Committee Chair Arrington said.

item.title: Arizona gun dealer armed two Mexican drug cartels, DOJ says
item.summary: An Arizona gun dealer was indicted on charges of allegedly providing weapons to the CJNG and Sinaloa Cartel, both designated foreign terrorist organizations.

item.title: Illegal immigrant accused of fatal hit and run that killed North Carolina motorcyclist
item.summary: An illegal immigrant is accused in a fatal alleged hit-and-run that killed motorcyclist Christopher Babcock, 62, in North Carolina, and an ICE detainer was filed.

item.title: Journalist tells San Francisco board ‘Nick Shirley’s coming to town’ amid fentanyl, crime concerns
item.summary: A public comment at the San Francisco Board of Supervisors raises concerns over fentanyl deaths, crime, and homelessness, as a speaker warns “Nick Shirley’s coming to town."

item.title: Jurors shown bodycam of doctor’s bloody wife, rock he allegedly used to bash her in cliffside attack
item.summary: Graphic bodycam footage and a bloodstained rock were shown to jurors in the attempted murder trial of Hawaii doctor Gerhardt Konig Wednesday.

item.title: Trump admin makes new criminal referrals to DOJ targeting New York AG Letitia James
item.summary: The Trump administration has made criminal referrals to the DOJ alleging New York AG Letitia James committed homeowners insurance fraud, officials confirmed.
